services.name: Kayak Rental
services.desc: Experience the glowing Indian River Lagoon without paddling! Drive your own two-person CraigCat while following a local guide on a unique bioluminescence adventure departing from Cape Crossing Marina. Cape Crossing Boat Rental’s craigcat tours do not require any prior experience and are fun for any age (Must be 18 or older to operate craigcat, children 5 and above are welcome to be the passengers on the craigcat). We offer all the instructions and quality equipment you will need to enjoy your adventure. Your local guide will not only keep you safe but will teach you all about the Indian River Lagoon and the native species that call it home. You may even see dolphins, manatees and other

blurb: Guests rent boats, pontoons, kayaks, paddleboards, and CraigCats to explore the Indian River Lagoon and Banana River. Rentals include equipment like GPS, life jackets, and safety gear. Bioluminescence tours are offered on CraigCats with a guide.
